items.title: Dave Brubeck — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Leroy Pearlman has mentioned that the Wolf Pack once played on a show with Marlene Dietrich.

ctx.x: He said, “I understand you knew my father. Do you remember much about him? Can you tell me how he played?” I said, “Oh, he was better than me,” and the guy started crying.
Leroy Pearlman has mentioned that the Wolf Pack once played on a show with Marlene Dietrich.
That’s the guy that built the truck, Pearlman.
